name: co-researcher
description: Academic research plugin for Codex: literature reviews, systematic reviews, peer review and citation checking, with every citation verified against OpenAlex, arXiv and Europe PMC

interface.shortDescription: Academic research plugin: literature reviews, systematic reviews and citation checking.
interface.longDescription: Co-Researcher is an academic research plugin covering literature review, critical analysis, hypothesis testing, quantitative and qualitative methods, peer review, ethics review, and grant writing. Features an intelligent orchestration engine that coordinates specialized research agents. Compatible with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, and OpenCode.
defaultPrompt: Review the literature on climate change mitigation strategies
Analyze the methodology of this research paper
Help me design a hypothesis-driven experiment
Write a grant proposal for my research project
